cc:Work.dc:description: RTX 4090; Nsight Systems kernel time, mean over 100 launches per measurement. 10 September 2026, RTX 4090 (sm_89), driver 591.74, WSL2, device idle. Each before/after pair was measured in one session with the same warp-up and the same inputs; Triton and cuTile references are quoted from their own sessions and are marked as such. Hatched bars are references from other sessions. See docs/assets/results/mage-007/kernel-lane-fixes.json for the values.
